scope: bounded content cache only; paired LAN mode is not implemented
note: every digest this path computes is an observed local digest checked against trusted metadata; none of it is publisher authenticity evidence. Completion from cache is reuse, not throughput, and no speed claim is made anywhere.

cases.proves: a flat digest and a piece-map digest over the same bytes are different identities
an identity survives rendering and parsing unchanged
malformed identity text is refused rather than guessed at
a trusted whole-file digest becomes a flat identity; non-digests are refused
piece order and piece length both change the identity
only credential-free entries report as shareable
provenance labels round-trip and reject unknown text
unverified content has no label, so it cannot be represented in the store
the index survives encoding and decoding with its accounting intact
a malformed index is refused whole rather than partially trusted
a truncated index is refused, so accounting cannot silently under-report
a use updates last-used time and nothing else
eviction candidate selection honours the skip set
removal reduces the accounted total
inserted bytes are retrievable and counted against the quota
insertion copies; it never consumes or moves the caller's file
re-inserting a known identity does not double-count its bytes
provenance persists across reopening and stays unshareable
a corrupted index is rebuilt from the directory, and rebuilt entries fail closed as credentialed
an oversize entry is refused; the store is not emptied to fit it
an entry larger than the whole quota is refused
a quota breach evicts the least recently used entry and only that one
a pinned entry survives quota pressure; insertion is refused instead
pinning an absent identity yields nothing
a verified hit returns the stored path and pins it until released
an absent identity is a miss, not an error
a tampered entry fails its check, is evicted, and its bytes are removed

a failed check cannot be resurrected by a second attempt
a mirror-delivered download reports a network delivery source
AUTHORIZED OFFLINE REUSE: with every mirror unreachable the download completes from cache, byte-identical and verified, with no mirror contacted
a verified network completion populates the cache

content with no trusted digest is never inserted

credential-free detection underlying provenance
